deep_f1_source_conic.realization: for any listed alpha write y=epsilon+2^(alpha-1)q; choose the odd q residue required by the first conic squareclass. The second conic is then a square because its normalized unit is 1 mod8.

deep_f1_full_cover_completion.shallow_g0_mu7: choose the allowed alpha giving Delta=-4; BW gives the minus root exactly when mu0=7 mod8
